hook: Your coffee isn't why you're broke
voiceover: Your five dollar coffee isn't why you're broke. Let's check the math. Five dollars a day is about one hundred fifty a month. Invested ten years at an assumed seven percent, that's roughly twenty-six thousand. Over thirty years, it's about one hundred eighty-three thousand. So the coffee isn't the villain. Time is. Old money knows small amounts only get big with decades. Cut what you don't care about, not what you love. Comment WEALTH for the free calculator.
ctaText: I’ll DM you the free calculator
caption: $150/mo (≈$5/day) at an assumed 7%: ~$26K after 10 years, ~$183K after 30. Time is the lever, not the latte. Comment WEALTH for the calculator. I'm an AI character. Education only, not financial advice.

sources: Math: FV $150/mo, monthly compounding, 7%: 120 months = $25,963; 360 months = $182,996
